title: Final Spin Wave Function
description: Essential Criteria: The student must provide the correct spin wave function for t > 0.

title: Fraction of Spins
description: Essential Criteria: The student must correctly derive the fraction of particles with spins in the +x, +y, and +z directions.

title: Transition Time Condition
description: Essential Criteria: The student must state the condition for the transition time to be valid.

title: Correct Use of Operators
description: Important Criteria: The student should correctly apply the Hamiltonian and spin operators in their calculations.

title: Initial Conditions
description: Important Criteria: The student must correctly identify and use the initial conditions for the spin wave function.

title: Precession Explanation
description: Optional Criteria: The student may explain the precession of the spin vector in the yz plane.

title: Unit Consistency
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student must ensure that all units are consistent throughout the calculations.

title: Sign Errors
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student should avoid common sign mistakes in the equations derived.
